recommended_approach: Use Mantaflow’s fluid simulation API by configuring a gas-style domain via `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings` and driving it with one or more emitter/flow objects via `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings`. The API indices also highlight domain/flow noise controls (e.g., `FluidDomainSettings.noise_strength`, `FluidDomainSettings.noise_time_anim`, and `FluidFlowSettings.noise_texture`) as key knobs to shape a small plume-like result.

key_parameters.bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.noise_stre: Domain noise intensity control (listed as an attribute of `FluidDomainSettings`).
key_parameters.bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.noise_time: Domain noise animation control (listed as an attribute of `FluidDomainSettings`).
key_parameters.bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings.noise_textur: Flow/emitter noise texture input/control (listed as an attribute of `FluidFlowSettings`).
key_parameters.bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.flip_ratio: Domain FLIP ratio control (listed as an attribute of `FluidDomainSettings`; may be relevant depending on chosen solver setup).
